new_records.scope: Realize D(2,3) and A(2) pieces, glue incompressible tori, and certify canonical JSJ using nonparallel unique fiber slopes. Negative orbifold Euler characteristics exclude solid-torus/product/Klein-bundle exceptions. Does not identify source-cover homeomorphism from a group isomorphism; only a constructed manifold model with that group is needed.
